text: On September 2, 2022, the City received an Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment application for 1366 Yonge Street (the "Site") to permit the construction of a 41-storey mixed-use building containing 489 dwelling units. The applicant appealed City Council's refusal of the Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment application (the "Appeal") to the Ontario Land Tribunal on May 17, 2023. On January 15, 2024, the applicant submitted revised plans to the Ontario Land Tribunal for the Site to permit the construction of a 49-storey mixed-use building containing 625 dwelling units. The City Solicitor requires further directions for the upcoming Ontario Land Tribunal hearing scheduled to commence on May 27, 2024. Given deadlines addressed in Confidential Attachment 1, this matter is urgent and cannot be deferred.

City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 3, 2024) from the City Solicitor, as amended by Motion 1 by Councillor Josh Matlow. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 3, 2024) from the City Solicitor, as amended by Motion 1 by Councillor Josh Matlow, and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (April 3, 2024) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 3, 2024) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
